study_identification_part.si_4_title: Capturing the Individual Deviations From Normative Models of Brain Structure for Depression Diagnosis and Treatment

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: HCP and REST-meta-MDD used to estimate normative models; Dataset I (MULTI-SITE) used for depression prediction (discovery cohort) and external validation (test set).
